summary:
Implementation plan for:
1. Eliminating all lingering white/light backgrounds in dashboard, modals, inputs, selects, and global CSS overrides.
2. Building ThemeContext for Dark (default) and Light mode with localStorage persistence and HTML 'dark' class management.
3. Defining CSS variables in index.css for both modes and updating select/input styling to stay consistent with the theme.
4. Adding an interactive Sun/Moon toggle button in HeaderNav next to the profile/user menu.
5. Updating CanvasRenderer wrapper background to deep dark (#0D131E) with subtle grid/dot pattern.
